AuthorizationDecision.title: AuthorizationDecision
AuthorizationDecision.description: Typed authorization decision over an exact request revision: allow/deny/not-applicable with typed reasons and exact evidence paths.

AuthorizationRecordVersion.title: AuthorizationRecordVersion
AuthorizationRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized authorization document (currently 1).

DecisionOutcome.title: DecisionOutcome
DecisionOutcome.description: Authorization decision outcome: allow, deny, or not-applicable (no policy applied — NOT an allow; consumers fail closed).

MessageId.title: MessageId
MessageId.description: Opaque message identifier, unique within the emitting scope.

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque principal identity: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug — the @epoch/identity id space.

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug — the @epoch/tenancy id space.

ResourceReference.title: ResourceReference
ResourceReference.description: The resource a request targets: a typed (resourceType, resourceId) reference pair, both opaque to authorization.

ResourceType.title: ResourceType
ResourceType.description: Resource class as a lowercase slug (e.g. "workspace", "world", "evidence") — provider-neutral.

ResourceId.title: ResourceId
ResourceId.description: Opaque resource identity (1..128 visible characters); the owning domain (tenancy, evidence, actions) defines the space.

ActionKind.title: ActionKind
ActionKind.description: Colon-namespaced action class, e.g. "world:write" or "evidence:append" — the same form as the W003 authority scopes.

DecisionReason.title: DecisionReason
DecisionReason.description: Typed decision reason: a closed code plus optional bounded human-auditable detail.

DecisionReasonCode.title: DecisionReasonCode
DecisionReasonCode.description: Typed decision reason: principal-verified, tenant-verified, policy-allows, policy-denies, or no-applicable-policy.

EvidencePath.title: EvidencePath
EvidencePath.description: Exact evidence path: the artifact revision backing a decision — opaque artifact id, revision label, and SHA-256 content digest (the @epoch/evidence exact-revision form).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
